review_text: Green Bread Cafe is such a hidden gem. The place has a calm, peaceful atmosphere that makes it perfect for slowing down, whether you’re catching up with someone or just enjoying some quiet time alone. It’s simple, cozy, and honestly just a really nice place to be. I haven’t had the chance to try their coffee yet, but the vibe alone already makes me want to come back.
had a chance to visit the 2nd branch. different vibes. same good food. and a great place to spend time with friends.

A coffee place without coffee? Plot twist because the machine had a problem when I arrived around 3:15 AM . But honestly, the friendly and apologetic staff somehow made the experience lighter. Since I’m not really into matcha, I just enjoyed taking photos and appreciating the place instead. From the outside, the café looks tiny and simple, but once you step inside, surprisingly spacious and relaxing pala. Sometimes it’s not always about the coffee — it’s also about the vibe, the people, and the little moments in between. Maybe no coffee today… but definitely a reason to come back next time.
